page.content:
Year-end official recap that turned from celebration to ratioed ritual.

How YouTube Rewind connects

  • Topic: YouTube — YouTube produced Rewind as an official year-in-review video.
  • Item: Dislike button — Rewind's later editions became famous for huge public dislike counts.

What is YouTube Rewind?

YouTube Rewind compiled viral clips and creators into an annual studio video. Later editions were so widely disliked that the series itself became platform folklore.

Key threads lead to YouTube and Dislike button.
